title: My study feed vs reality (Vex, Scribe; the 'Me vs My Insta Feed' trend, her apartment; lighter persona, no mommy lines)

voice.name: Dolly (generic Fish library voice, breathy British; the user's pick, alternating with Mommy)

beats.say: My study feed versus my actual life. Let's be honest.
My feed: five AM study session. Candles. Matcha. Reality: it's five PM, and I just woke up.
My feed: colour-coded notes. Reality: one sticky note that says, homework, question mark.
My feed: healthy study snacks. Reality: cold pizza. From Tuesday.
But my homework? Looks exactly the same in both.
Scribe writes it in my handwriting, and I even pick the paper. Yellow legal pad, because it looks expensive.
My feed says effortless. Honestly? It is. Try to keep up.
